models.description: List of models to deploy with this {@link #spec}.

trainJobRun.description:
All trained models produced by the {@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} will be deployed with this {@link #spec}.
Furthermore, unless otherwise specified in the {@link #spec}, the subject filter of the deployment will match
the subject filter of training.

spec.description: Configuration for the deployment. In particular, this holds the specification of the subject filter.
